text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day after school—

text_block_list.name: Horse Girls
text_block_list.text: Tra-cen, fight, oh! Fight, oh!
Yo, Cafe!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
You trainin' now? If you want, we can do 
some match racing!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Splendid idea! Do not hold back, go at it 
with full force! Allow me to observe 
thoroughly!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...No. ...I only came to see how things 
were. Excuse me...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
What the heck, she took off. Didn't she 
come here to run...?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(...As expected... the daytime is too 
loud... Everyone is... overflowing with 
life...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
(—...Unless I am alone... my 'friend's' 
presence... feels so distant............)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry for speaking up so suddenly... 
It's rare to run into someone here.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Did you run all the way here alone, too?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
............Yes... Today... the academy 
felt... too loud...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, I know what you mean.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
When I'm alone, I'm free... 
I can run as far as I want,
wherever my heart leads. 
Because that... feels so wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...I... suppose you're right...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Still, then why... call out to me...? 
When you, Suzuka-san... 
finally had some time... all to yourself...
right...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah—that's because I thought Air Groove 
would've told you the same thing.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Air Groove-san... is that you...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Right. Like, 'Get back here now!' 
'Are you trying to break dorm curfew?!',
surely.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...When I run alone, sometimes 
I can hear Air Groove's voice saying things
like that.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
'Once you're satisfied with one person,
come back.' 
When I hear that, 
my legs naturally head toward the dorm—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu... It's strange, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
A voice that somehow comes to mind whenever
I'm aloneâ 
It always warms my heart...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...A voice...
I remember when I'm all alone...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You there!
Interested in boosting your stamina!? 
Come, no need to be shy!
I happen to have an experimental 
device under development right nowâoh?
Why are you running away?

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oi, oi, who d'ya think you are, 
hoggin' the whole track like that?! 
Wanna settle this, punk?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...How... utterly disgraceful...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
When I think...
they might be causing trouble... 
I feel like... I have to get home...
right away...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Fufu, so you were the one worrying.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
In that case, shall we head back soon? 
Because time spent not being alone 
is surely precious, too...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Passing by the school gates in the
evening, 
I saw Jungle Pocket and the others 
looking as if they were waiting for
someone—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there! 
Have you seen Cafe around?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
They wander off every now and then,
you see. 
And just when I had an experiment 
I wanted them to take part in—
choice_data_list: Any idea where they might have gone?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
They wander off every now and then,
you see. 
And just when I had an experiment 
I wanted them to take part in—
choice_data_list: Any idea where they might have gone?
Do you have any idea where they mi...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... nah, it's fine! I'm sure she'll be 
back before curfew anyway.
choice_data_list: Any idea where they might have gone?
Do you have any idea where they mi...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
I'll just wait here a bit longer.
Thanks a 
bunch!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, the two continued looking 
around.
It seemed Manhattan Cafe was truly 
blessed with great friends—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed...
I have a fairly good idea of the 
places Cafe might frequent. We have known 
each other quite some time, after all—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Alright,
we cannot just stand idly by! Let 
us go retrieve her at once!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Alright, count me in too—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon and Jungle Pocket darted
off 
in different directions. I prayed they 
would manage to meet up safely—
